						local offset = (fy + fz * DIV) * ROW_BYTES
						writeu16(scratch, offset, bor(readu16(scratch, offset), row))
					end
				end
				setStatic(k, intern(scratch))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Marks many boxes at once (`boxes`: lo, hi pairs on the FINE grid, e.g.
-- from refineShape). Each touched cell is edited in one private copy and
-- interned once at the end -- marking them one by one through markStatic
-- would intern (and keep forever) every intermediate state of every cell,
-- which for a big mesh's ~10^5 voxels was gigabytes.
local function markVoxels(boxes: { Vector3 })
	local pending: { [number]: buffer } = {}
	for index = 1, #boxes, 2 do
		local lo, hi = boxes[index], boxes[index + 1]
		local fx0, fy0, fz0 = math.round(lo.X / FINE), math.round(lo.Y / FINE), math.round(lo.Z / FINE)
		local fx1, fy1, fz1 = math.round(hi.X / FINE) - 1, math.round(hi.Y / FINE) - 1, math.round(hi.Z / FINE) - 1
		for cz = fz0 // DIV, fz1 // DIV do
			local az, bz = max(fz0 - cz * DIV, 0), min(fz1 - cz * DIV, DIV - 1)
			for cy = fy0 // DIV, fy1 // DIV do
				local ay, by = max(fy0 - cy * DIV, 0), min(fy1 - cy * DIV, DIV - 1)
				for cx = fx0 // DIV, fx1 // DIV do
					local ax, bx = max(fx0 - cx * DIV, 0), min(fx1 - cx * DIV, DIV - 1)
					local k = cellKey(cx, cy, cz)
					local mask = pending[k]
					if not mask then
						local current = static[k]
						if current == FULL then
							continue
						end
						mask = buffer.create(MASK_BYTES)
						if current then
							buffer.copy(mask, 0, current, 0, MASK_BYTES)
						end
						pending[k] = mask
					end
					local row = lshift(lshift(1, bx - ax + 1) - 1, ax)
					for fz = az, bz do
						for fy = ay, by do
							local offset = (fy + fz * DIV) * ROW_BYTES
							writeu16(mask, offset, bor(readu16(mask, offset), row))
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for k, mask in pending do
		if not static[k] then
			stats.StaticCells += 1
		end
		setStatic(k, intern(mask))
	end
end

local function markDynamicBox(lo: Vector3, hi: Vector3, owner: Instance)
	for cz = floor(lo.Z / COARSE), floor(hi.Z / COARSE) do
		for cy = floor(lo.Y / COARSE), floor(hi.Y / COARSE) do
			for cx = floor(lo.X / COARSE), floor(hi.X / COARSE) do
				local k = cellKey(cx, cy, cz)
				local boxes = dynamic[k]
				if not boxes then
					boxes = {}
					dynamic[k] = boxes
				end
				table.insert(boxes, lo)
				table.insert(boxes, hi)
				table.insert(boxes, owner)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Re-marks every moving part, once per physics frame (all queries in one
-- Heartbeat see the same world).
local function refreshDynamic()
	local stamp = workspace.DistributedGameTime
	if stamp == dynamicStamp then
		return
	end
	dynamicStamp = stamp
	table.clear(dynamic)
	local count = 0
	local largest, largestSize = nil, 0
	for part in dynamicParts do
		if not part.Parent then
			dynamicParts[part] = nil
			continue
		end
		count += 1
		local size = part.Size.Magnitude
		if size > largestSize then
			largest, largestSize = part, size
		end
		local reach = PAD + DYNAMIC_MARGIN + part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * DYNAMIC_LOOKAHEAD
		local lo, hi = bounds(part, reach)
		local owner = ownerOf[part]
		if not owner or not owner.Parent then
			local node: Instance = part
			while node.Parent and node.Parent ~= workspace do
				node = node.Parent :: Instance
			end
			owner = node
			ownerOf[part] = node
		end
		markDynamicBox(lo, hi, owner :: Instance)
	end
	stats.DynamicParts = count
	stats.LargestDynamic = if largest then `{largest:GetFullName()} ({math.floor(largestSize)})` else nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Classification
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function inCharacter(part: BasePart): boolean
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model do
		if model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return true
		end
		model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	end
	return false
end

-- Is this part's collision shape its own box?
local function boxShaped(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part:IsA("Part") and (part :: Part).Shape == Enum.PartType.Block
end

-- The boxes (lo, hi pairs on the FINE grid) covering `part`'s real
-- collision geometry, each tested grown by PAD (so marking them needs no
-- further padding): its box is split into octants and a piece is kept only
-- if GetPartsInPart finds the part in it. Pieces stop at a power-of-two
-- `leaf` near 1/REFINE_DIVISIONS of the part (so a 900-stud tree costs about
-- what a 50-stud rock does), and past REFINE_MAX_PROBES whatever is left is
-- kept whole (still safe, just coarser). Yields every REFINE_SLICE; nil if the
-- part left the world meanwhile.
local probe = Instance.new("Part")
probe.Anchored = true

local function leafFor(part: BasePart): number
	local size = part.Size
	local wanted = max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) / REFINE_DIVISIONS
	local leaf = FINE
	while leaf < wanted and leaf < COARSE do
		leaf *= 2
	end
	return leaf
end

local function refineShape(part: BasePart): { Vector3 }?
	local initialFrame, initialSize = part.CFrame, part.Size
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { part }
	local grow = Vector3.one * (2 * PAD)
	local leaf = leafFor(part)
	local lo, hi = bounds(part, 0)
	lo = Vector3.new(floor(lo.X / leaf) * leaf, floor(lo.Y / leaf) * leaf, floor(lo.Z / leaf) * leaf)
	hi = Vector3.new(math.ceil(hi.X / leaf) * leaf, math.ceil(hi.Y / leaf) * leaf, math.ceil(hi.Z / leaf) * leaf)
	local boxes: { Vector3 } = {}
	local stack: { Vector3 } = { lo, hi }
	local sliceStarted = os.clock()
	local probes = 0
	-- an axis range split in two on the leaf grid (one range if it's one leaf)
	local function halves(a: number, b: number): { number }
		if b - a <= leaf then
			return { a, b }
		end
		local m = a + math.ceil((b - a) / leaf / 2) * leaf
		return { a, m, m, b }
	end
	while #stack > 0 do
		local nodeHi = table.remove(stack) :: Vector3
		local nodeLo = table.remove(stack) :: Vector3
		if probes >= REFINE_MAX_PROBES then
			-- out of budget: keep the rest whole
			table.insert(boxes, nodeLo)
			table.insert(boxes, nodeHi)
			continue
		end
		if os.clock() - sliceStarted > REFINE_SLICE then
			refineCpu += os.clock() - sliceStarted
			refineYields += 1
			task.wait()
			sliceStarted = os.clock()
			if not part.Parent or part.CFrame ~= initialFrame or part.Size ~= initialSize then
				return nil
			end
		end
		probes += 1
		refineProbes += 1
		probe.Size = nodeHi - nodeLo + grow
		probe.CFrame = CFrame.new((nodeLo + nodeHi) * 0.5)
		if #workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe, params) == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local size = nodeHi - nodeLo
		if size.X <= leaf and size.Y <= leaf and size.Z <= leaf then
			table.insert(boxes, nodeLo)
			table.insert(boxes, nodeHi)
			continue
		end
		local xs, ys, zs = halves(nodeLo.X, nodeHi.X), halves(nodeLo.Y, nodeHi.Y), halves(nodeLo.Z, nodeHi.Z)
		for i = 1, #xs, 2 do
			for j = 1, #ys, 2 do
				for k = 1, #zs, 2 do
					table.insert(stack, Vector3.new(xs[i], ys[j], zs[k]))
					table.insert(stack, Vector3.new(xs[i + 1], ys[j + 1], zs[k + 1]))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	refineCpu += os.clock() - sliceStarted
	return boxes
end

-- Workers never bake: static parts stay dynamic until a current mask/pose
-- record arrives from the publisher (ApplyBake).
local shaped: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {} -- (worker) boxes already applied
local watched: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}

local function actorsFolder(): Instance?
	return game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("ProjectileActors", true)
end

-- Bake masks once. Transfer deduplicated immutable buffers at startup and
-- changed-cell deltas afterwards; workers keep ordinary local table/buffer
-- reads in the hot path (no SharedTable lookup/string conversion per sweep).
local function packet(full: boolean): any
	local keys, ids, unique, indices, parts = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local source = if full then static else dirtyCells
	for key in source do
		local mask = static[key]
		if mask then
			local index = indices[mask]
			if not index then
				index = #unique + 1; indices[mask] = index; unique[index] = mask
			end
			table.insert(keys, key); table.insert(ids, index)
		end
	end
	local partSource = if full then publishedParts else dirtyParts
	for part in partSource do
		local record = publishedParts[part]
		if record and part.Parent then table.insert(parts, record) end
	end
	return {Version = revision, Full = full, Keys = keys, MaskIds = ids, Masks = unique, Parts = parts,
		Ready = ready, HasTerrain = hasTerrain, TerrainMin = terrainMin, TerrainMax = terrainMax}
end

local publishQueued = false
local function publish()
	publishQueued = false
	if isWorker or not startupDone then return end
	local folder = actorsFolder()
	if not folder then return end
	revision += 1
	local update = packet(revision == 1)
	table.clear(dirtyCells); table.clear(dirtyParts)
	for _, actor in folder:GetChildren() do
		if actor:IsA("Actor") then actor:SendMessage("OccupancyBake", update) end
	end
end
schedulePublish = function()
	if isWorker or not startupDone or publishQueued then return end
	publishQueued = true
	task.defer(publish)
end

if not isWorker then
	task.spawn(function()
		local folder = actorsFolder()
		while not folder do task.wait(0.5); folder = actorsFolder() end
		local function sendAll(actor: Actor)
			if startupDone and actor.Parent then actor:SendMessage("OccupancyBake", packet(true)) end
		end
		local hello = (folder :: Instance):WaitForChild("OccupancyHello") :: BindableEvent
		hello.Event:Connect(sendAll)
		for _, actor in (folder :: Instance):GetChildren() do
			if actor:IsA("Actor") then sendAll(actor) end
		end
	end)
end

local queryWatched: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}

local function makeDynamic(part: BasePart)
	if not dynamicParts[part] then
		dynamicParts[part] = true
		dynamicStamp = -1 -- the current frame's marks no longer cover it
	end
end

local classify: (part: BasePart) -> ()

-- A static part moved (or its anchoring changed): mark where it is now, and
-- give up on it as static if it keeps moving or stopped being anchored.
local function staticChanged(part: BasePart)
	if not part.Parent or dynamicParts[part] then
		return
	end
	if isWorker then
		-- Until a current publisher record arrives, moved geometry is dynamic.
		-- Never trust a stale snapshot at its new location.
		makeDynamic(part)
		return
	end
	local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
	if not (part.Anchored or (root and root.Anchored)) then
		makeDynamic(part)
		return
	end
	local moves = (staticMoves[part] or 0) + 1
	staticMoves[part] = moves
	if moves >= DEMOTE_AFTER_MOVES then
		makeDynamic(part)
		return
	end
	local lo, hi = bounds(part, PAD)
	markStatic(lo, hi)
	rememberPart(part)
end

local function watchStatic(part: BasePart)
	part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		staticChanged(part)
	end)
	part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
		staticChanged(part)
	end)
	part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
		staticChanged(part)
	end)
	-- Parts welded to an anchored root move with it without their own CFrame
	-- signal firing, and become loose if the root is unanchored: watch the root.
	local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
	if root and root ~= part then
		local list = watchedRoots[root]
		if not list then
			list = {}
			watchedRoots[root] = list
			local function rootChanged()
				for _, member in list do
					staticChanged(member)
				end
			end
			root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(rootChanged)
			root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(rootChanged)
		end
		table.insert(list, part)
	end
end

local refineQueue: {BasePart} = {}
local refineQueued: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
local refining = false
local function queueRefinement(part: BasePart)
	if refineQueued[part] then return end
	refineQueued[part] = true
	table.insert(refineQueue, part)
	if refining then return end
	refining = true
	task.defer(function()
		local started, completed = os.clock(), 0
		local cpuBefore, probesBefore, yieldsBefore = refineCpu, refineProbes, refineYields
		for _, candidate in refineQueue do
			if candidate.Parent then
				local boxes = refineShape(candidate)
				local root = candidate.AssemblyRootPart
				if boxes and candidate.Parent and candidate.CanQuery
					and (candidate.Anchored or (root and root.Anchored)) and not inCharacter(candidate) then
					local markStarted = os.clock()
					markVoxels(boxes)
					refineCpu += os.clock() - markStarted
					rememberPart(candidate)
					dynamicParts[candidate] = nil
					if not watched[candidate] then watched[candidate] = true; watchStatic(candidate) end
					completed += 1
				end
			end
			refineQueued[candidate] = nil
		end
		table.clear(refineQueue)
		refining = false
		print(string.format("[Projectile] occupancy refinement complete: %d shapes, %d cells, %.0f ms wall / %.0f ms CPU, %d probes, %d yields (base grid already usable)",
			completed, stats.StaticCells, (os.clock() - started) * 1000, (refineCpu - cpuBefore) * 1000,
			refineProbes - probesBefore, refineYields - yieldsBefore))
	end)
end

function classify(part: BasePart)
	if part:IsA("Terrain") or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return
	end
	if not part.CanQuery then
		-- raycasts can't hit it: nothing to mark until that changes
		dynamicParts[part] = nil
		if not queryWatched[part] then
			queryWatched[part] = true
			part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanQuery"):Connect(function()
				if part.CanQuery and part.Parent then
					makeDynamic(part)
					task.spawn(classify, part)
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
	local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
	local anchored = part.Anchored or (root ~= nil and root.Anchored)
	if not anchored or inCharacter(part) then
		makeDynamic(part)
		return
	end
	if isWorker then
		if not shaped[part] then makeDynamic(part) end
		if not watched[part] then watched[part] = true; watchStatic(part) end
		return -- workers import finished masks; no box/shape/terrain bake
	end
	local size = part.Size
	if (size.X > REFINE_OVER or size.Y > REFINE_OVER or size.Z > REFINE_OVER) and not boxShaped(part) then
		makeDynamic(part) -- (conservative while its shape is probed)
		queueRefinement(part)
		return
	else
		local lo, hi = bounds(part, PAD)
		markStatic(lo, hi)
	end
	rememberPart(part)
	dynamicParts[part] = nil
	if not watched[part] then
		watched[part] = true
		watchStatic(part)
	end
end

-- Serial Actor handler. Buffers are already baked and deduplicated by the
-- publisher; adopt them directly, never rebuild voxel masks in each Actor.
function Occupancy.ApplyBake(update: any): boolean
	if not isWorker then return true end
	if update.Version < revision then return hasSnapshot end
	-- Never enable skipping from a partial/missed delta. A late worker (or a
	-- gap in delivery) requests a fresh snapshot and casts normally meanwhile.
	if not update.Full and (not hasSnapshot or update.Version > revision + 1) then
		ready = false
		hasSnapshot = false
		return false
	end
	if update.Full then hasSnapshot = true end
	local started = os.clock()
	local first = not importedReady
	revision = update.Version
	-- Intern once per received mask, not per cell/query. Deltas can contain a
	-- pattern already received in an earlier packet; keep just one local copy.
	local importedMasks = table.create(#update.Masks)
	for index, mask in update.Masks do importedMasks[index] = intern(mask) end
	for index, key in update.Keys do
		if not static[key] then stats.StaticCells += 1 end
		static[key] = importedMasks[update.MaskIds[index]]
	end
	for _, record in update.Parts do
		local part = record[1]
		if part.Parent and part.CFrame == record[2] and part.Size == record[3] and part.CanQuery
			and (part.Anchored or (part.AssemblyRootPart and part.AssemblyRootPart.Anchored)) and not inCharacter(part) then
			shaped[part] = true
			dynamicParts[part] = nil
			if not watched[part] then watched[part] = true; watchStatic(part) end
		end
	end
	dynamicStamp = -1
	hasTerrain, terrainMin, terrainMax = update.HasTerrain, update.TerrainMin, update.TerrainMax
	importedReady = update.Ready
	ready = startupDone and importedReady
	if first and importedReady then
		print(string.format("[Projectile] occupancy imported (no bake): %d cells, %.2f ms", stats.StaticCells, (os.clock() - started) * 1000))
	end
	return true
end

-- A joint went away: its parts may now be loose, so stop trusting them as static.
local function jointRemoved(joint: Instance)
	for _, name in { "Part0", "Part1" } do
		local part = (joint :: any)[name]
		if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored then
			makeDynamic(part)
		end
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Query
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function fineOccupied(fx: number, fy: number, fz: number): boolean
	local cx, cy, cz = fx // DIV, fy // DIV, fz // DIV
	local k = cellKey(cx, cy, cz)
	local moving = dynamic[k]
	if moving then
		local x0, y0, z0 = fx * FINE, fy * FINE, fz * FINE
		local x1, y1, z1 = x0 + FINE, y0 + FINE, z0 + FINE
		local ignore = currentIgnore
		for index = 1, #moving, 3 do
			local lo, hi = moving[index], moving[index + 1]
			if x1 > lo.X and x0 < hi.X and y1 > lo.Y and y0 < hi.Y and z1 > lo.Z and z0 < hi.Z
				and not (ignore and ignore[moving[index + 2]]) then
				blockedByMoving = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	local mask = static[k]
	if not mask then
		return false
	end
	local lx, ly, lz = fx - cx * DIV, fy - cy * DIV, fz - cz * DIV
	return btest(readu16(mask, (ly + lz * DIV) * ROW_BYTES), lshift(1, lx))
end

local function coarseOccupied(cx: number, cy: number, cz: number): boolean
	local k = cellKey(cx, cy, cz)
	return dynamic[k] ~= nil or static[k] ~= nil
end

-- Amanatides-Woo walk of every `size`-stud voxel the segment passes through;
-- true as soon as `occupied` says one is.
local function walk(origin: Vector3, displacement: Vector3, size: number, occupied: (number, number, number) -> boolean): boolean
	local x, y, z = origin.X / size, origin.Y / size, origin.Z / size
	local dx, dy, dz = displacement.X / size, displacement.Y / size, displacement.Z / size
	local ix, iy, iz = floor(x), floor(y), floor(z)
	local ex, ey, ez = floor(x + dx), floor(y + dy), floor(z + dz)
	local sx = if dx > 0 then 1 elseif dx < 0 then -1 else 0
	local sy = if dy > 0 then 1 elseif dy < 0 then -1 else 0
	local sz = if dz > 0 then 1 elseif dz < 0 then -1 else 0
	local inf = math.huge
	local tx = if dx > 0 then (ix + 1 - x) / dx elseif dx < 0 then (x - ix) / -dx else inf
	local ty = if dy > 0 then (iy + 1 - y) / dy elseif dy < 0 then (y - iy) / -dy else inf
	local tz = if dz > 0 then (iz + 1 - z) / dz elseif dz < 0 then (z - iz) / -dz else inf
	local ux = if dx ~= 0 then 1 / abs(dx) else inf
	local uy = if dy ~= 0 then 1 / abs(dy) else inf
	local uz = if dz ~= 0 then 1 / abs(dz) else inf
	local steps = abs(ex - ix) + abs(ey - iy) + abs(ez - iz) + 1
	for _ = 1, steps do
		if occupied(ix, iy, iz) then
			return true
		end
		if tx <= ty and tx <= tz then
			ix += sx
			tx += ux
		elseif ty <= tz then
			iy += sy
			ty += uy
		else
			iz += sz
			tz += uz
		end
	end
	-- floating-point slack: the end voxel is always checked
	return occupied(ex, ey, ez)
end

-- Is the whole segment (plus padding) inside the scanned terrain area?
local function insideTerrainScan(origin: Vector3, finish: Vector3): boolean
	local lo = origin:Min(finish) - Vector3.one * PAD
	local hi = origin:Max(finish) + Vector3.one * PAD
	return lo.X >= terrainMin.X and lo.Y >= terrainMin.Y and lo.Z >= terrainMin.Z
		and hi.X <= terrainMax.X and hi.Y <= terrainMax.Y and hi.Z <= terrainMax.Z
end

-- True when a sweep of `radius` from `origin` along `displacement` provably
-- hits nothing, so the caller can skip its raycast. Conservative: any doubt
-- (not baked yet, too wide, outside scanned terrain, anything near the path)
-- returns false.
-- `ignore` (optional): instances the caller's raycast excludes (with their
-- descendants); moving parts belonging to them don't block.
function Occupancy.SegmentClear(origin: Vector3, displacement: Vector3, radius: number,
	ignore: { [Instance]: boolean }?): boolean
	stats.Checks += 1
	if not ready or not Occupancy.Enabled then
		stats.NotReady += 1
		return false
	end
	if radius > Occupancy.MaxRadius then
		stats.TooWide += 1
		return false
	end
	if hasTerrain and not insideTerrainScan(origin, origin + displacement) then
		stats.OutsideTerrain += 1
		return false
	end
	refreshDynamic()
	if walk(origin, displacement, COARSE, coarseOccupied) then
		stats.Coarse += 1
		blockedByMoving = false
		currentIgnore = ignore
		local blocked = walk(origin, displacement, FINE, fineOccupied)
		currentIgnore = nil
		if blocked then
			stats.Blocked += 1
			if blockedByMoving then
				stats.BlockedMoving += 1
			end
			return false
		end
	end
	stats.Skipped += 1
	return true
end

-- Counters since the last call (DebugService's Stats tab), then reset.
function Occupancy.TakeStats()
	local snapshot = table.clone(stats)
	snapshot.Ready = ready
	stats.Checks, stats.Skipped, stats.Coarse = 0, 0, 0
	stats.NotReady, stats.TooWide, stats.OutsideTerrain, stats.Blocked, stats.BlockedMoving = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	return snapshot
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Terrain
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function snap(value: number, toward: number): number
	return if toward < 0 then floor(value / FINE) * FINE else math.ceil(value / FINE) * FINE
end

-- Reads terrain between `lo` and `hi` in TERRAIN_BLOCK batches (yielding
-- between them) and marks every solid voxel; contiguous x-runs are marked as
-- one box. Water is skipped (projectile rays ignore it).
function Occupancy.BakeTerrain(lo: Vector3, hi: Vector3)
	local terrain = workspace.Terrain
	lo = Vector3.new(snap(lo.X, -1), snap(lo.Y, -1), snap(lo.Z, -1))
	hi = Vector3.new(snap(hi.X, 1), snap(hi.Y, 1), snap(hi.Z, 1))
	local air, water = Enum.Material.Air, Enum.Material.Water
	local pad = Vector3.one * PAD
	for bz = lo.Z, hi.Z - 1, TERRAIN_BLOCK do
		for by = lo.Y, hi.Y - 1, TERRAIN_BLOCK do
			for bx = lo.X, hi.X - 1, TERRAIN_BLOCK do
				local blockLo = Vector3.new(bx, by, bz)
				local blockHi = Vector3.new(min(bx + TERRAIN_BLOCK, hi.X), min(by + TERRAIN_BLOCK, hi.Y), min(bz + TERRAIN_BLOCK, hi.Z))
				local ok, materials = pcall(terrain.ReadVoxels, terrain, Region3.new(blockLo, blockHi), FINE)
				if ok then
					local size = materials.Size
					for z = 1, size.Z do
						for y = 1, size.Y do
							local runStart: number? = nil
							for x = 1, size.X + 1 do
								local material = if x <= size.X then materials[x][y][z] else air
								local solid = material ~= air and material ~= water
								if solid and not runStart then
									runStart = x
								elseif not solid and runStart then
									local voxelLo = blockLo + Vector3.new((runStart - 1) * FINE, (y - 1) * FINE, (z - 1) * FINE)
									local voxelHi = blockLo + Vector3.new((x - 1) * FINE, y * FINE, z * FINE)
									markStatic(voxelLo - pad, voxelHi + pad)
									runStart = nil
								end
							end
						end
					end
				else
					warn("[Projectile] occupancy: terrain read failed, that area stays unscanned:", materials)
				end
				task.wait()
			end
		end
	end
end

-- The area to scan: the map's anchored parts plus a margin, or the default area.
local function terrainScanArea(parts: { BasePart }): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, part in parts do
		if part.Parent and part.Anchored then
			lo, hi = lo:Min(part.Position), hi:Max(part.Position)
		end
	end
	if lo.X > hi.X then
		return TERRAIN_DEFAULT_MIN, TERRAIN_DEFAULT_MAX
	end
	local margin = Vector3.one * TERRAIN_AROUND_PARTS
	return lo - margin, hi + margin
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Startup: watch first (so nothing appears unseen), then bake in batches
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		-- dynamic until proven anchored: never skip past a part spawned this frame
		makeDynamic(instance)
		task.defer(function()
			if instance.Parent then
				classify(instance)
			end
		end)
	end
end)
workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		dynamicParts[instance] = nil
		staticMoves[instance] = nil
		queryWatched[instance] = nil
		ownerOf[instance] = nil
		shaped[instance] = nil
		publishedParts[instance] = nil
		dirtyParts[instance] = nil
		watched[instance] = nil
	elseif instance:IsA("JointInstance") or instance:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
		jointRemoved(instance)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local started = os.clock()
	local parts = {}
	for _, descendant in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts, descendant)
		end
	end
	for index, part in parts do
		if part.Parent then
			classify(part)
		end
		if index % BAKE_BATCH == 0 then
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	startupDone = true
	if isWorker then
		ready = importedReady
		return -- startup classification only; static masks come from the publisher
	end
	local ok, cells = pcall(function()
		return workspace.Terrain:CountCells()
	end)
	if not ok or cells > 0 then
		hasTerrain = true
		terrainMin, terrainMax = terrainScanArea(parts)
		publish() -- unready snapshot: terrain must remain conservative until scanned
		Occupancy.BakeTerrain(terrainMin, terrainMax)
	end
	ready = true
	publish()
	print(string.format("[Projectile] occupancy base baked once: %d parts%s, %d cells, %.0f ms (shape refinement continues safely in background)", #parts,
		if hasTerrain then " + terrain" else "", stats.StaticCells, (os.clock() - started) * 1000))
end)

return Occupancy
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/Projectile/Occupancy.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/Projectile/Homing.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Projectile/Homing.luau
	Target acquisition and steering. Homing.update(projectile, dt) runs once
	per substep from init.luau's Step; it only ever changes the projectile's
	HomingTarget, its homing timers, and the direction of its Velocity.
]]

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local ChunkManager = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ChunkManager"))
local Entity = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Entity"))

local Math = require(script.Parent.Math)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

type State = Types.State

local Homing = {}

function Homing.targetPosition(target: Types.HomingTarget?): Vector3?
	if target == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if typeof(target) == "Vector3" then
		return target
	end
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if target:IsA("BasePart") then
			return target.Position
		elseif target:IsA("Model") then
			return target:GetPivot().Position
		end
		return nil
	end
	-- an Entity
	if target.IsDestroyed then
		return nil
	end
	return target:GetPosition()
end

local function isEligible(projectile: State, homing: Types.Homing, entity: Types.EntityLike): boolean
	if entity == projectile.Source or entity.IsDestroyed then
		return false
	end
	local filter = projectile.Filter
	if filter and not filter(entity) then
		return false
	end
	local tags = homing.TargetTags
	if tags then
		for _, tag in tags do
			if entity:HasTag(tag) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	elseif homing.TargetTag then
		return entity:HasTag(homing.TargetTag)
	end
	return true
end

-- Finds the nearest valid homing target: entities matching TargetTag/TargetTags
-- (or ALL entities if neither given), excluding the projectile's own Source and
-- anything its Filter rejects. Uses ChunkManager's spatial index when
-- AcquireRadius is set (the normal case -- every real spawn site sets one), so
-- cost scales with local entity density, not total entity/projectile count; the
-- unbounded case (rare) falls back to a full scan.
function Homing.acquireTarget(projectile: State, homing: Types.Homing, position: Vector3): Types.EntityLike?
	local function eligible(entity: Types.EntityLike): boolean
		return isEligible(projectile, homing, entity)
	end

	local radius = homing.AcquireRadius
	local candidates: { Types.EntityLike }
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	if radius then
		candidates = ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInRadius(position, radius, { Filter = eligible })
		bestDistance = radius
	else
		candidates = {}
		local pool = if homing.TargetTag then Entity.GetTagged(homing.TargetTag) else Entity.GetAll()
		for _, entity in pool do
			if eligible(entity) then
				table.insert(candidates, entity)
			end
		end
	end

	local best: Types.EntityLike? = nil
	for _, entity in candidates do
		local distance = (entity:GetPosition() - position).Magnitude
		if distance <= bestDistance then
			best, bestDistance = entity, distance
		end
	end
	return best
end

function Homing.update(projectile: State, dt: number)
	local homing = projectile.Homing
	if not homing then
		return
	end

	if projectile.HomingDelay > 0 then
		projectile.HomingDelay -= dt
		return
	end

	-- (re)acquire a target when none / auto-targeting
	local target = projectile.HomingTarget
	local targetGone = target == nil or Homing.targetPosition(target) == nil

	if targetGone then
		if homing.AcquireRadius or homing.TargetTag or homing.TargetTags then
			projectile._acquireTimer -= dt
			if projectile._acquireTimer <= 0 then
				-- Jittered so a burst fired on one frame spreads its searches
				-- across frames instead of spiking together forever.
				projectile._acquireTimer = homing.AcquireInterval * (0.5 + math.random())
				target = Homing.acquireTarget(projectile, homing, projectile.Position)
				projectile.HomingTarget = target
			end
		end
	elseif not homing.Permalock and homing.Retarget and target ~= homing.Target then
		-- (a target passed in the config -- homing.Target, e.g. a spell's "Lock
		-- on" -- is a lock: rechecking for the nearest only re-evaluates targets
		-- the projectile picked itself. If the locked one goes away, targetGone
		-- above falls back to normal acquisition.)
		projectile.ReacquireTimer -= dt
		if projectile.ReacquireTimer <= 0 then
			projectile.ReacquireTimer = homing.ReacquireRate
			-- No `or target` fallback: if nothing is in range anymore, the lock
			-- is genuinely dropped. Homing.Permalock (checked above) is the
			-- explicit opt-in for "never drop a lock due to range."
			target = Homing.acquireTarget(projectile, homing, projectile.Position)
			projectile.HomingTarget = target
		end
	end

	local goal = Homing.targetPosition(target)
	if not goal then
		return
	end
	local speed = projectile.Velocity.Magnitude
	local newDirection = Math.rotateTowards(projectile.Velocity, goal - projectile.Position, homing.TurnRate * dt)
	projectile.Velocity = newDirection * speed
end

return Homing
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/Projectile/Homing.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/Projectile/RewindHit.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Projectile/RewindHit.luau
	Lag-compensated ("rewound") entity hit detection -- the authoritative hit
	check for any shot fired with RewindSeconds > 0 (see Shooter.server.luau),
	which in practice is almost every real networked shot.

	RewindHit.check only answers "which entity, if any, does this segment hit
	from the shooter's point of view"; resolving what the hit does (pierce,
	destroy, events) is Raycast.resolveEntityHit's job.
]]

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local Entity = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Entity"))
local ChunkManager = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ChunkManager"))
local SafeMath = require(Shared:WaitForChild("SafeMath"))

local Math = require(script.Parent.Math)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

type State = Types.State

type Candidate = {
	entity: Types.EntityLike,
	point: Vector3,
	distAlong: number,
	hurtbox: Types.Hurtbox,
}

local RewindHit = {}

-- Reused by every check (the server step is single-threaded, and each check
-- drains it before returning) to avoid per-substep allocation churn.
local candidates: { Candidate } = {}

local function byDistance(a: Candidate, b: Candidate): boolean
	return a.distAlong < b.distAlong
end

-- Lag-compensated entity check for one movement substep. Only meaningful while
-- passing through a chunk that contains entities (see `highRes` in init.luau's
-- Step) and only for shots that carry a positive RewindSeconds. Builds its
-- hurtbox whitelist directly from the (loaded) chunk(s) the segment touches --
-- not a radius sweep -- so a projectile only ever considers entities actually
-- in a loaded chunk it's in, per-shooter-desync.
--
-- Two memoization/deferral choices preserve the exact "nearest in-range entity
-- with a clear LOS to `from`" semantics while cutting redundant work:
--  - The rewind instant (os.clock() - RewindSeconds) is pinned for the whole
--    Step (see init.luau), and each entity's rewound position is memoized in
--    projectile._rewindCache, so an entity rewinds once per frame rather than
--    once per substep.
--  - LOS verification is deferred: in-range candidates are sorted nearest
--    first and LOS-checked in that order, so the raycast count is the rank of
--    the nearest clear candidate rather than every candidate.
-- Returns entity, contact point, surface normal, hurtbox -- or nil.
function RewindHit.check(
	projectile: State,
	from: Vector3,
	to: Vector3
): (Types.EntityLike?, Vector3?, Vector3?, Types.Hurtbox?)
	local whitelist: { [Types.EntityLike]: boolean } = {}
	for _, position in { from, to } do
		local chunk = ChunkManager.GetChunk(position)
		if chunk and ChunkManager.IsChunkActive(chunk) then
			for entity in chunk.Entities do
				whitelist[entity] = true
			end
		end
	end

	-- Each entity is tested against BOTH its rewound Head and Body spheres --
	-- Head is checked first and wins outright if in range (the two spheres
	-- are independent, not required to nest -- see Entity.luau).
	local filter = projectile.Filter
	local cache = projectile._rewindCache
	for entity in whitelist do
		if entity ~= projectile.Source and not projectile._ignore[entity] and (not filter or filter(entity)) then
			local rewound = cache[entity]
			if not rewound then
				rewound = {
					Body = entity:GetBodyPositionAt(projectile._rewindTime),
					Head = entity:GetHeadPositionAt(projectile._rewindTime),
				}
				cache[entity] = rewound
			end

			local head = rewound.Head
			local matchedHead = false
			if head then
				local closest, distance = Math.closestPointOnSegment(head, from, to)
				if distance <= entity.HeadRadius + projectile.Radius then
					local candidate: Candidate = {
						entity = entity,
						point = closest,
						distAlong = (closest - from).Magnitude,
						hurtbox = "Head",
					}
					table.insert(candidates, candidate)
					matchedHead = true
				end
			end
			if not matchedHead then
				local closest, distance = Math.closestPointOnSegment(rewound.Body, from, to)
				if distance <= entity.HitboxRadius + projectile.Radius then
					local candidate: Candidate = {
						entity = entity,
						point = closest,
						distAlong = (closest - from).Magnitude,
						hurtbox = "Body",
					}
					table.insert(candidates, candidate)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(candidates, byDistance)

	for _, candidate in candidates do
		-- line-of-sight: real geometry must not block the shot before it would
		-- reach this point, so stale rewound data can never be used to hit
		-- someone through a wall. The hit instance must not belong to the
		-- candidate itself, so a target's own body can't block hitting it.
		local los = workspace:Raycast(from, candidate.point - from, projectile._rayParams)
		local blocked = los ~= nil
			and (los.Position - from).Magnitude < candidate.distAlong - 0.5
			and Entity.Get(los.Instance) ~= candidate.entity
		if not blocked then
			table.clear(candidates)
			return candidate.entity,
				candidate.point,
				SafeMath.direction(from - candidate.point, Vector3.yAxis),
				candidate.hurtbox
		end
	end

	table.clear(candidates)
	return nil, nil, nil, nil
end

return RewindHit
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/Projectile/RewindHit.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/Projectile/Replication.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Projectile/Replication.luau
	Everything that pushes projectile state from the server to rendering
	clients (see ProjectileClient (ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Projectile.Client) for the
	receiving side, and Shared.Projectile.Protocol for the wire format). The
	server stays authoritative; this module only ever sends -- see the
	top-level Projectile doc comment (init.luau) for the protocol's design.

	Per frame, init.luau's step loop calls, in order:
	 flushHitBatch                   (start of frame, bounded)
	 Step -> updateTimeScale / updateSyncState / queueBounce / queueHit
	 queuePose -> refine/collide beam links
	 flushSpawnBatch                 (completed snapshots, bounded)
	 flushMoveBatch                   (end of frame, bounded round-robin)
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local VisualOffload = require(Shared:WaitForChild("VisualOffload"))
local Protocol = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Projectile"):WaitForChild("Protocol"))
local Codec = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Projectile"):WaitForChild("Codec"))
local Heartbeat = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Heartbeat"))

local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

type State = Types.State

local Channels = Protocol.Channels

local Replication = {}

-- Bounded per-frame work so one client event never grows without bound.
local MAX_SPAWNS_PER_FRAME = 1000
local MAX_HITS_PER_FRAME = 1000
-- Homing poses are round-robined past this; the cursor advances in real frame
-- order and is never reset by dilation, so changing GlobalTimeScale cannot
-- merge staggered cohorts into one spike.
local MAX_POSES_PER_FRAME = 2500
-- Beam geometry is reconstructed locally. Ballistic safety snapshots are
-- sparse; homing and topology/clipping/time changes are never rate-throttled.
local BEAM_REFRESH = 0.5
local beamSnapshots: { [number]: any } = {}

local function rememberBeam(projectile: State, now: number)
	if not projectile.Beam then return end
	beamSnapshots[projectile.Id] = {
		Time = now, PreviousId = projectile.Beam.PreviousId or 0,
		Clipped = projectile._beamSpanClipped == true,
		Path = table.clone(projectile._beamSpan or {}),
		Scale = Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale(), PersonalScale = projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale,
	}
end

local function beamDue(projectile: State, now: number): boolean
	if projectile.HomingTarget then return true end
	local previous = beamSnapshots[projectile.Id]
	if not previous then return true end
	if previous.PreviousId ~= (projectile.Beam.PreviousId or 0)
		or previous.Clipped ~= (projectile._beamSpanClipped == true)
		or previous.Scale ~= Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale()
		or previous.PersonalScale ~= projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale then return true end
	local path = projectile._beamSpan or {}
	if #path ~= #previous.Path then return true end
	-- Bend vertices and clipped endpoints are world anchors, not predictions.
	for index = 2, #path - (if projectile._beamSpanClipped then 0 else 1) do
		if (path[index] - previous.Path[index]).Magnitude > 0.05 then return true end
	end
	return now - previous.Time >= BEAM_REFRESH
end

-- When on, prints every ProjSpawn/ProjSync/ProjTimeScale/ProjHit as it is
-- streamed (individually rare enough to log one line each), plus a
-- once-a-second rate summary for ProjMove. Toggled via Projectile.SetDebugSync.
Replication.DebugSync = false

-- One queued, range-limited message payload.
type Entry = {
	Range: number,
	Position: Vector3,
	Payload: any,
	Recipients: { [Player]: boolean }?,
	Chunk: buffer?, -- Payload encoded once (binary channels), shared by every recipient
}

type BounceSnap = {
	Projectile: State,
	Point: Vector3,
	Normal: Vector3,
	Corrected: boolean?,
}

local spawnQueue: { State } = {}
local spawnQueueHead = 1
local hitQueue: { Entry } = {}
local hitQueueHead = 1
local pendingBounces: { BounceSnap } = {} -- flushed with this frame's ProjMove
local pendingBounceHead = 1
local poseCandidates: { State } = {} -- homing and beam correction candidates
local poseCursor = 1
local moveStats = { batches = 0, entries = 0 }
local beamStats = { Candidates = 0, Updates = 0 }

-- Only finite-range visuals need interest bookkeeping. Unlimited-range
-- stress tests retain the broadcast fast path. The persistent cursor limits
-- re-entry checks independently of simulation/dilation and spawn cohorts.
local interests: { [number]: { Projectile: State, Observers: { [Player]: boolean } } } = {}
local interestOrder: { number } = {}
local interestCursor = 1
local interestCount = 0
local frameRoots: { [Player]: BasePart }? = nil

local function playerRoots(): { [Player]: BasePart }
	local roots: { [Player]: BasePart } = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character.PrimaryPart
		if root then
			roots[player] = root
		end
	end
	return roots
end

-- Sends each entry to every player within its Range (everyone when the range
-- is unlimited), as ONE event per recipient no matter how many entries.
-- With `encode` (ProjMove / ProjHitBatch -- see Projectile.Codec) each entry is
-- encoded once and every recipient's message is one packed buffer of them.
local function fanOut(channel: string, entries: { Entry }, encode: ((any) -> buffer)?)
	if #entries == 0 then
		return
	end
	local function item(entry: Entry): any
		if not encode then
			return entry.Payload
		end
		local chunk = entry.Chunk
		if not chunk then
			chunk = encode(entry.Payload)
			entry.Chunk = chunk
		end
		return chunk
	end
	local function message(list: { any }): any
		return if encode then Codec.Join(list) else list
	end
	local broadcast: { any } = {}
	local perPlayer: { [Player]: { any } } = {}
	local roots: { [Player]: BasePart }? = nil
	for _, entry in entries do
		if entry.Recipients then
			for player in entry.Recipients do
				if not player.Parent then continue end
				local list = perPlayer[player] or {}
				perPlayer[player] = list
				table.insert(list, item(entry))
			end
		elseif entry.Range >= math.huge then
			table.insert(broadcast, item(entry))
		else
			roots = roots or playerRoots()
			for player, root in roots :: { [Player]: BasePart } do
				if (root.Position - entry.Position).Magnitude <= entry.Range then
					local list = perPlayer[player]
					if not list then
						list = {}
						perPlayer[player] = list
					end
					table.insert(list, item(entry))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #broadcast > 0 then
		VisualOffload.Fire(channel, message(broadcast))
	end
	for player, list in perPlayer do
		VisualOffload.FireClient(player, channel, message(list))
	end
end

-- Sends one immediate (unbatched) message about `projectile`.
local function streamTo(projectile: State, channel: string, payload: any)
	if not projectile.Visualize then
		return
	end
	-- State changes that happen while a visual is still waiting in the bounded
	-- spawn queue are folded into its eventual spawn snapshot. Sending them
	-- first would create out-of-order client state for visuals not built yet.
	if not projectile._spawnStreamed then
		return
	end
	if projectile.VisualRange >= math.huge then
		VisualOffload.Fire(channel, payload)
		return
	end
	local interest = interests[projectile.Id]
	for player in interest and interest.Observers or {} do
		if player.Parent then
			VisualOffload.FireClient(player, channel, payload)
		end
	end
end

-- Ordinary homing retains its pose stream. Beam endpoints are predicted at
-- one common client epoch, with sparse ballistic snapshots and immediate
-- authoritative steering/topology/clipping/bounce corrections.
function Replication.isSynced(projectile: State): boolean
	return projectile.HomingTarget ~= nil and projectile.Beam == nil
end

-- Fields equal to ProjectileClient's defaults are omitted: remote events
-- serialize every key name per entry, so at batch sizes the defaults were most
-- of the spawn bandwidth.
local function spawnPayload(projectile: State): Protocol.SpawnPayload
	local payload: Protocol.SpawnPayload = {
		Id = projectile.Id,
		Position = projectile.Position,
		Velocity = projectile.Velocity,
		Lifetime = math.max(projectile.Lifetime - projectile.Age, 0),
		MaxRealLifetime = math.max(projectile.MaxRealLifetime - (os.clock() - projectile._spawnRealTime), 0),
		AccelerationDirection = projectile.AccelerationDirection,
		Model = projectile.Model,
		Visual = projectile.Visual,
	}
	if projectile.Gravity ~= 0 then payload.Gravity = projectile.Gravity end
	if projectile.Acceleration ~= 0 then payload.Acceleration = projectile.Acceleration end
	if projectile.MinSpeed ~= 0 then payload.MinSpeed = projectile.MinSpeed end
	if projectile.MaxSpeed ~= math.huge then payload.MaxSpeed = projectile.MaxSpeed end
	if Replication.isSynced(projectile) then payload.Synced = true end
	if projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale ~= 1 then payload.TimeScale = projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale end
	if projectile.VisualScale ~= 1 then payload.VisualScale = projectile.VisualScale end
	if projectile.Beam then
		payload.ServerTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		payload.GlobalScale = Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale()
		payload.Beam = { Length = projectile.Beam.Length, Radius = projectile.Radius,
			Origin = if projectile.Beam.ChannelId then projectile.Position else projectile._beamOrigin or projectile.Position,
			ChannelId = projectile.Beam.ChannelId, PreviousId = projectile.Beam.PreviousId,
			Path = projectile._beamSpan, Clipped = projectile._beamSpanClipped }
	end
	if projectile.DestroyDelay ~= 0 then payload.DestroyDelay = projectile.DestroyDelay end
	if not projectile.WaitForParticles then payload.WaitForParticles = false end
	if not projectile.WaitForTrails then payload.WaitForTrails = false end
	if projectile.ActivateParticlesOnCreate then payload.ActivateParticlesOnCreate = true end
	return payload
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifecycle messages
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Queues the visual's creation; it spawns from its latest pose when flushed.
function Replication.spawnVisual(projectile: State)
	if not projectile.Visualize then
		return
	end
	if Replication.DebugSync then
		print(`[Relativity][sync] queued ProjSpawn Id={projectile.Id} Synced={Replication.isSynced(projectile)}`)
	end
	table.insert(spawnQueue, projectile)
end

-- Destruction is queued for the same reason creation is: a mass expiry must
-- become a few bounded batch messages, not thousands of individual remote
-- invocations in one frame. A projectile that dies before its queued spawn
-- was streamed needs no hit message because no client visual exists yet.
function Replication.queueHit(projectile: State, info: Types.DestroyInfo)
	beamSnapshots[projectile.Id] = nil
	if Replication.DebugSync then
		print(`[Relativity][sync] ProjHit Id={projectile.Id} Kind={info.Kind or "fizzle"}`)
	end
	if not projectile.Visualize or not projectile._spawnStreamed then
		return
	end
	local payload: Protocol.HitPayload = {
		Id = projectile.Id,
		Position = info.Position,
		Normal = info.Normal,
		Kind = info.Kind,
		BeamBody = projectile._beamBodyHit,
		BeamPath = projectile._beamSpan,
		BeamClipped = projectile._beamSpanClipped,
	}
	local interest = interests[projectile.Id]
	table.insert(hitQueue, { Range = projectile.VisualRange, Position = info.Position, Payload = payload,
		Recipients = interest and table.clone(interest.Observers) })
	interests[projectile.Id] = nil
	if interest then interestCount -= 1 end
end

-- Compacts a head-indexed queue once its consumed prefix dominates it.
local function compact<T>(queue: { T }, head: number): ({ T }, number)
	if head > #queue then
		table.clear(queue)
		return queue, 1
	elseif head > 4096 and head > #queue / 2 then
		return table.move(queue, head, #queue, 1, {}), 1
	end
	return queue, head
end

function Replication.flushHitBatch()
	local batch: { Entry } = {}
	local last = math.min(#hitQueue, hitQueueHead + MAX_HITS_PER_FRAME - 1)
	for index = hitQueueHead, last do
		table.insert(batch, hitQueue[index])
	end
	hitQueue, hitQueueHead = compact(hitQueue, last + 1)
	fanOut(Channels.HitBatch, batch, Codec.EncodeHit)
end

-- Sends at most MAX_SPAWNS_PER_FRAME new visuals per frame, combined into one
-- RemoteEvent per recipient. Simulation starts immediately on the server;
-- queued visuals spawn from their latest authoritative pose, so batching never
-- rewinds or slows gameplay.
function Replication.flushSpawnBatch()
	frameRoots = playerRoots()
	local batch: { Entry } = {}
	local exits: { [Player]: { number } } = {}
	local remaining = MAX_SPAWNS_PER_FRAME
	local last = math.min(#spawnQueue, spawnQueueHead + remaining - 1)
	for index = spawnQueueHead, last do
		local projectile = spawnQueue[index]
		if projectile.Dead then continue end
		projectile._spawnStreamed = true
		local payload = spawnPayload(projectile)
		projectile._streamedSynced = payload.Synced == true
		rememberBeam(projectile, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		local recipients
		if projectile.VisualRange < math.huge then
			recipients = {}
			for player, root in frameRoots :: { [Player]: BasePart } do
				if (root.Position-projectile.Position).Magnitude <= projectile.VisualRange then recipients[player] = true end
			end
			interests[projectile.Id] = { Projectile = projectile, Observers = recipients }
			interestCount += 1
			table.insert(interestOrder, projectile.Id)
		end
		table.insert(batch, { Range = projectile.VisualRange, Position = projectile.Position, Payload = payload, Recipients = recipients })
		remaining -= 1
	end
	spawnQueue, spawnQueueHead = compact(spawnQueue, last + 1)
	-- At most 2500 checks and 1000 creation/re-entry snapshots in a frame.
	-- Hysteresis prevents churn when the player sits on the range boundary.
	for _ = 1, math.min(#interestOrder, MAX_POSES_PER_FRAME) do
		if interestCursor > #interestOrder then interestCursor = 1 end
		local id = interestOrder[interestCursor]
		interestCursor += 1
		local interest = interests[id]
		if not interest then continue end
		local projectile, observers = interest.Projectile, interest.Observers
		local entering: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for player in observers do
			local root = (frameRoots :: { [Player]: BasePart })[player]
			if not root or (root.Position-projectile.Position).Magnitude > projectile.VisualRange*1.1+8 then
				observers[player] = nil
				if player.Parent then
					local list = exits[player] or {}; exits[player] = list
					table.insert(list, id)
				end
			end
		end
		for player, root in frameRoots :: { [Player]: BasePart } do
			if not observers[player] and remaining > 0 and (root.Position-projectile.Position).Magnitude <= projectile.VisualRange then
				entering[player], observers[player] = true, true
			end
		end
		if next(entering) then
			table.insert(batch, { Range = projectile.VisualRange, Position = projectile.Position,
				Payload = spawnPayload(projectile), Recipients = entering })
			remaining -= 1
		end
	end
	for player, ids in exits do VisualOffload.FireClient(player, Channels.RangeExit, ids) end
	fanOut(Channels.SpawnBatch, batch)
	if #interestOrder > 4096 and #interestOrder > 2*interestCount then
		local ordered = {}
		for offset = 0, #interestOrder-1 do
			local id = interestOrder[(interestCursor+offset-1)%#interestOrder+1]
			if interests[id] then table.insert(ordered,id) end
		end
		interestOrder, interestCursor = ordered, 1
	end
end
function Replication.getQueueStats()
	return {
		VisualSpawnsPerFrame = MAX_SPAWNS_PER_FRAME,
		VisualHitsPerFrame = MAX_HITS_PER_FRAME,
		PendingVisualSpawns = math.max(#spawnQueue - spawnQueueHead + 1, 0),
		PendingVisualHits = math.max(#hitQueue - hitQueueHead + 1, 0),
		BeamPoseCandidates = beamStats.Candidates,
		BeamPoseUpdates = beamStats.Updates,
		BeamRefreshInterval = BEAM_REFRESH,
		BeamHomingRefreshInterval = 0,
	}
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State changes (sent immediately, only when something actually changed)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Tells clients the combined Source.TimeScale * projectile.TimeScale only
-- when it CHANGES -- see the "Local time" section in init.luau. In the common
-- case (nobody touches it after firing) this never fires after spawn.
function Replication.updateTimeScale(projectile: State, combinedScale: number)
	if combinedScale == projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale then
		return
	end
	projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale = combinedScale
	if Replication.DebugSync then
		print(`[Relativity][sync] ProjTimeScale Id={projectile.Id} TimeScale={combinedScale}`)
	end
	local payload: Protocol.TimeScalePayload = { Id = projectile.Id, TimeScale = combinedScale }
	streamTo(projectile, Channels.TimeScale, payload)
end

-- Tells clients only when the homing-sync state actually changed. True
-- switches the client into "trust the continuous ProjMove stream" mode; false
-- switches it back to local physics. The authoritative pose rides on this
-- message: it is sent immediately (mid-step) over the same ordered remote as
-- ProjMove, so a separate end-of-frame pose would arrive after the client had
-- already left synced mode and be discarded -- and the round-robin cap could
-- skip it entirely.
function Replication.updateSyncState(projectile: State)
	local synced = Replication.isSynced(projectile)
	if synced == projectile._streamedSynced then
		return
	end
	projectile._streamedSynced = synced
	if Replication.DebugSync then
		print(`[Relativity][sync] ProjSync Id={projectile.Id} Synced={synced}`)
	end
	local payload: Protocol.SyncPayload = {
		Id = projectile.Id,
		Synced = synced,
		Position = projectile.Position,
		Velocity = projectile.Velocity,
	}
	streamTo(projectile, Channels.Sync, payload)
end

-- Debug visualization of one movement cast (see Projectile.SetDebugRays).
function Replication.streamRay(projectile: State, from: Vector3, to: Vector3, lowRes: boolean)
	local payload: Protocol.RayPayload = { From = from, To = to, LowRes = lowRes }
	streamTo(projectile, Channels.Ray, payload)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pose stream (ProjMove)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- One-shot bounce snap (see Raycast.resolveHit). Queued rather than fired so
-- a volley bouncing off one floor costs one event per recipient, not one per
-- projectile. Ordering still holds: this frame's flushMoveBatch sends it, and
-- any ProjHit for the same projectile is flushed at the start of a LATER frame.
-- Only the contact point/normal are captured now; the snapped pose is read at
-- flush time, i.e. the end-of-frame pose, the same time base as ProjSpawn and
-- the homing stream. A mid-frame pose would leave the client behind by the
-- rest of the frame the server kept simulating after the bounce.
function Replication.queueBounce(projectile: State, point: Vector3, normal: Vector3)
	if not projectile.Visualize or not projectile._spawnStreamed then
		return
	end
	table.insert(pendingBounces, { Projectile = projectile, Point = point, Normal = normal })
end

function Replication.queueCorrection(projectile: State, point: Vector3, normal: Vector3)
	if not projectile.Visualize or not projectile._spawnStreamed then return end
	table.insert(pendingBounces, { Projectile = projectile, Point = point, Normal = normal, Corrected = true })
end

-- Collects homing/beam candidates. Beam cadence and topology are checked AFTER
-- link refinement; payloads are built only for the bounded slice actually sent.
function Replication.queuePose(projectile: State)
	if projectile.Visualize and projectile._spawnStreamed and (projectile._streamedSynced or projectile.Beam ~= nil) then
		table.insert(poseCandidates, projectile)
	end
end

local function poseEntry(projectile: State): Entry
	local payload: Protocol.MovePayload = {
		Id = projectile.Id,
		Position = projectile.Position,
		Velocity = projectile.Velocity,
		BeamPath = projectile._beamSpan,
		BeamClipped = projectile._beamSpanClipped,
		BeamPreviousId = if projectile.Beam then projectile.Beam.PreviousId or 0 else nil,
		ServerTime = if projectile.Beam then workspace:GetServerTimeNow() else nil,
		GlobalScale = if projectile.Beam then Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale() else nil,
		TimeScale = if projectile.Beam then projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale else nil,
		Lifetime = if projectile.Beam then math.max(projectile.Lifetime-projectile.Age, 0) else nil,
	}
	local interest = interests[projectile.Id]
	return { Range = projectile.VisualRange, Position = projectile.Position, Payload = payload,
		Recipients = if projectile.VisualRange < math.huge then interest and interest.Observers or {} else nil }
end

-- Sends this frame's bounce snaps plus a bounded round-robin slice of the
-- queued homing poses, as one ProjMove event per recipient.
function Replication.flushMoveBatch()
	local batch: { Entry } = {}
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local sent: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	local lastBounce = math.min(#pendingBounces, pendingBounceHead+MAX_POSES_PER_FRAME-1)
	for index = pendingBounceHead, lastBounce do
		local bounce = pendingBounces[index]
		local projectile = bounce.Projectile
		local payload: Protocol.MovePayload = {
			Id = projectile.Id,
			Position = projectile.Position,
			Velocity = projectile.Velocity,
			Bounced = if bounce.Corrected then nil else true,
			Corrected = bounce.Corrected,
			BeamPreviousId = if projectile.Beam then projectile.Beam.PreviousId or 0 else nil,
			ServerTime = if projectile.Beam then now else nil,
			GlobalScale = if projectile.Beam then Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale() else nil,
			TimeScale = if projectile.Beam then projectile._lastStreamedTimeScale else nil,
			BeamPath = projectile._beamSpan,
			BeamClipped = projectile._beamSpanClipped,
			Lifetime = if projectile.Beam then math.max(projectile.Lifetime-projectile.Age, 0) else nil,
			Point = bounce.Point,
			Normal = bounce.Normal,
		}
		local interest = interests[projectile.Id]
		sent[projectile.Id] = true
		if projectile.Beam then beamStats.Updates += 1 end
		if not projectile.Dead then rememberBeam(projectile, now) end
		table.insert(batch, { Range = projectile.VisualRange, Position = projectile.Position, Payload = payload,
			Recipients = if projectile.VisualRange < math.huge then interest and interest.Observers or {} else nil })
	end
	pendingBounces, pendingBounceHead = compact(pendingBounces, lastBounce+1)

	local due = {}
	for _, projectile in poseCandidates do
		if projectile.Beam then beamStats.Candidates += 1 end
		if not projectile.Dead and not sent[projectile.Id]
			and (not projectile.Beam or beamDue(projectile, now)) then table.insert(due, projectile) end
	end
	table.clear(poseCandidates)
	local candidateCount = #due
	if candidateCount > 0 then
		local updateCount = math.min(candidateCount, math.max(MAX_POSES_PER_FRAME-#batch, 0))
		if poseCursor > candidateCount then
			poseCursor = (poseCursor - 1) % candidateCount + 1
		end
		for offset = 0, updateCount - 1 do
			local projectile = due[(poseCursor + offset - 1) % candidateCount + 1]
			table.insert(batch, poseEntry(projectile))
			if projectile.Beam then beamStats.Updates += 1 end
			rememberBeam(projectile, now)
		end
		poseCursor = (poseCursor + updateCount - 1) % candidateCount + 1
	else
		poseCursor = 1
	end

	if Replication.DebugSync and #batch > 0 then
		moveStats.batches += 1
		moveStats.entries += #batch
	end
	fanOut(Channels.Move, batch, Codec.EncodeMove)
end

-- Once-a-second ProjMove rate summary (see DebugSync) -- real time, not
-- dilated, so the reporting cadence stays steady even mid-freeze.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		if Replication.DebugSync and moveStats.batches > 0 then
			print(`[Relativity][sync] ProjMove rate: {moveStats.batches} batches/s, {moveStats.entries} projectile-updates/s`)
		end
		moveStats.batches = 0
		moveStats.entries = 0
	end
end)

return Replication
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/Projectile/Replication.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/Projectile/Store.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Projectile/Store.luau
	The hot half of every live projectile, packed into buffers.

	A projectile is still the table Projectile.new returns, and every field
	reads and writes as before (projectile.Position, projectile.Velocity = v,
	projectile.Dead, ...). But the fields touched every frame live in the
	column buffers here (see Layout) instead of in the table, behind the table's metatable. The
	per-frame loops (Parallel's dispatch/apply, the server step loop) read the
	records directly, so a projectile that just flies never has its table
	touched -- a 45-field table is ~2 KB of scattered hash nodes, and at
	100k+ projectiles each field read was roughly a cache miss.

	Layout: structure-of-arrays, one buffer ("column") per group of fields
	used together, indexed by slot. Measured on the apply pass at 180k
	projectiles, columns beat one 96-byte record per projectile by ~40% with
	slots in random order (and ~5x on the step loop's mark/flag reads): each
	hot column is small enough to stay in cache.
	  Motion  24 B  Position, Velocity (3 x f32 each; Vector3 is float32: exact)
	  Time    16 B  Age f64, _simulationDebt f64
	  Marks    4 B  _sweepMark i32 (0 when unset)
	  Flags    1 B  Dead, Dirty, _spawnStreamed, _streamedSynced, and
	                Visualize / Beam ~= nil (fixed at adopt)
	  Scales  16 B  TimeScale f64 (its OWN scale; non-numbers are stored as 1,
	                which is what combinedTimeScale made of them anyway),
	                Source u32 (index into a refcounted source list, 0: none)
	  Homing  24 B  HomingDelay, _acquireTimer, ReacquireTimer (f64; homing's
	                timers, so a homing projectile's worker result is applied
	                straight from buffers too)
	  Cold    32 B  Id, _spawnRealTime, _lastStreamedTimeScale, _parallelState
	                (f64 each; touched at spawn / death / repack, not per frame)
	The buffers are replaced when they grow, so read Store.Motion etc. afresh
	rather than keeping them across anything that can spawn a projectile.

	EFFICIENT projectiles (the default for plain shots, see Projectile.new)
	have no table of their own beyond a tiny handle ({ _slot }): everything
	constant per config lives in one shared, frozen spec (Spec.luau), and the
	handle's metatable (Store.HandleMetatable) reads a field from, in order:
	the record, the handle's own extras (`_x`, created by the first write of
	a non-record field -- that projectile's override), lazily created values
	(signals, scratch tables), the spec, then the class. Writing a motion
	constant (Gravity, Radius...) also marks the record Dirty, so the worker
	repacks it next frame.

	Dirty is set by any write of a motion field (Position, Velocity, Age,
	_simulationDebt, TimeScale, Dead) through the table: it tells Parallel the
	worker's copy is stale, instead of comparing every field per frame.
	Parallel clears it when it repacks the projectile.

	Lifetime: adopt() moves a new table's hot fields in; release() (when the
	step loop drops it from `active`) copies them back out as plain fields, so
	a handle a caller kept keeps working, and frees the slot. Generation[slot]
	counts releases, so a stale reference to a reused slot can be recognised.
]]

local Store = {}

-- column strides (bytes per slot)
local MOTION, TIME, MARKS, SCALES, COLD, HOMING = 24, 16, 4, 16, 32, 24
Store.MotionStride, Store.TimeStride, Store.MarkStride, Store.ScaleStride = MOTION, TIME, MARKS, SCALES
Store.ColdStride = COLD -- (Id 0, _spawnRealTime 8, _lastStreamedTimeScale 16, _parallelState 24)
Store.HomingStride = HOMING -- (HomingDelay 0, _acquireTimer 8, ReacquireTimer 16)

local DEAD, DIRTY, SPAWN_STREAMED, SYNCED, VISUALIZE, BEAM = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32
Store.Dead, Store.Dirty, Store.SpawnStreamed, Store.Synced, Store.Visualize, Store.Beam =
	DEAD, DIRTY, SPAWN_STREAMED, SYNCED, VISUALIZE, BEAM

local readf32, writef32, readf64, writef64 = buffer.readf32, buffer.writef32, buffer.readf64, buffer.writef64
local readu8, writeu8, readu32, writeu32 = buffer.readu8, buffer.writeu8, buffer.readu32, buffer.writeu32
local readi32, writei32 = buffer.readi32, buffer.writei32
local band, bor, bnot = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bnot

local capacity = 1024
Store.Motion = buffer.create(capacity * MOTION)
Store.Time = buffer.create(capacity * TIME)
Store.Marks = buffer.create(capacity * MARKS)
Store.Flags = buffer.create(capacity)
Store.Scales = buffer.create(capacity * SCALES)
Store.Cold = buffer.create(capacity * COLD)
Store.HomingTimers = buffer.create(capacity * HOMING)
Store.Generation = {} :: { number } -- [slot] = times released
local used = 0 -- slots ever handed out
local free: { number } = {}

-- Sources (the shooter Entity), shared by many projectiles: [index] = source.
Store.Sources = {} :: { any }
local sourceIndex: { [any]: number } = {}
local sourceRefs: { number } = {}
local freeSources: { number } = {}

-- Hot fields and their kind.
local HOT: { [string]: number } = {
	Position = 1, Velocity = 2, Age = 3, _simulationDebt = 4, TimeScale = 5,
	Dead = 6, _spawnStreamed = 7, _streamedSynced = 8, _sweepMark = 9,
	Id = 10, _spawnRealTime = 11, _lastStreamedTimeScale = 12, _parallelState = 13,
	HomingDelay = 14, _acquireTimer = 15, ReacquireTimer = 16,
}
Store.HotFields = HOT
local KIND_COUNT = 16
local MOTION_LAST = 6 -- kinds 1..6 mark the record Dirty when written

local NAN = 0 / 0
local BAD_POSITION = Vector3.new(NAN, NAN, NAN) -- fails isFiniteVector, so Step expires it

local function readVector(b: buffer, o: number): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(readf32(b, o), readf32(b, o + 4), readf32(b, o + 8))
end

local function writeVector(b: buffer, o: number, v: Vector3)
	writef32(b, o, v.X)
	writef32(b, o + 4, v.Y)
	writef32(b, o + 8, v.Z)
end

local function flag(slot: number, bitValue: number, on: boolean)
	local flags = readu8(Store.Flags, slot)
	writeu8(Store.Flags, slot, if on then bor(flags, bitValue) else band(flags, bnot(bitValue)))
end

local function read(slot: number, kind: number): any
	if kind == 1 then
		return readVector(Store.Motion, slot * MOTION)
	elseif kind == 2 then
		return readVector(Store.Motion, slot * MOTION + 12)
	elseif kind == 3 then
		return readf64(Store.Time, slot * TIME)
	elseif kind == 4 then
		return readf64(Store.Time, slot * TIME + 8)
	elseif kind == 5 then
		return readf64(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES)
	elseif kind == 6 then
		return band(readu8(Store.Flags, slot), DEAD) ~= 0
	elseif kind == 7 then
		return band(readu8(Store.Flags, slot), SPAWN_STREAMED) ~= 0
	elseif kind == 8 then
		return band(readu8(Store.Flags, slot), SYNCED) ~= 0
	elseif kind == 9 then
		return readi32(Store.Marks, slot * MARKS)
	elseif kind == 10 then
		return readf64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD)
	elseif kind == 11 then
		return readf64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD + 8)
	elseif kind == 12 then
		return readf64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD + 16)
	elseif kind == 13 then
		local state = readf64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD + 24)
		return if state == 0 then nil else state
	end
	return readf64(Store.HomingTimers, slot * HOMING + (kind - 14) * 8)
end

local function write(slot: number, kind: number, value: any)
	if kind == 1 then
		writeVector(Store.Motion, slot * MOTION, if typeof(value) == "Vector3" then value else BAD_POSITION)
	elseif kind == 2 then
		-- (Step turns a non-vector Velocity into zero; same here)
		writeVector(Store.Motion, slot * MOTION + 12, if typeof(value) == "Vector3" then value else Vector3.zero)
	elseif kind == 3 then
		writef64(Store.Time, slot * TIME, tonumber(value) or 0)
	elseif kind == 4 then
		writef64(Store.Time, slot * TIME + 8, tonumber(value) or 0)
	elseif kind == 5 then
		writef64(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES, if type(value) == "number" then value else 1)
	elseif kind == 6 then
		flag(slot, DEAD, value == true)
	elseif kind == 7 then
		flag(slot, SPAWN_STREAMED, value == true)
	elseif kind == 8 then
		flag(slot, SYNCED, value == true)
	elseif kind == 9 then
		writei32(Store.Marks, slot * MARKS, tonumber(value) or 0)
	elseif kind == 10 then
		writef64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD, tonumber(value) or 0)
	elseif kind == 11 then
		writef64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD + 8, tonumber(value) or 0)
	elseif kind == 12 then
		writef64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD + 16, tonumber(value) or 1)
	elseif kind == 13 then
		writef64(Store.Cold, slot * COLD + 24, tonumber(value) or 0)
	else
		writef64(Store.HomingTimers, slot * HOMING + (kind - 14) * 8, tonumber(value) or 0)
	end
	if kind <= MOTION_LAST then
		flag(slot, DIRTY, true)
	end
end

local function grow(old: buffer, stride: number): buffer
	local grown = buffer.create(capacity * 2 * stride)
	buffer.copy(grown, 0, old, 0, capacity * stride)
	return grown
end

-- A fresh slot, every column zeroed.
local function allocate(): number
	local slot = table.remove(free)
	if not slot then
		slot = used
		used += 1
		if used > capacity then
			Store.Motion = grow(Store.Motion, MOTION)
			Store.Time = grow(Store.Time, TIME)
			Store.Marks = grow(Store.Marks, MARKS)
			Store.Flags = grow(Store.Flags, 1)
			Store.Scales = grow(Store.Scales, SCALES)
			Store.Cold = grow(Store.Cold, COLD)
			Store.HomingTimers = grow(Store.HomingTimers, HOMING)
			capacity *= 2
		end
		Store.Generation[slot] = 0
	end
	buffer.fill(Store.Motion, slot * MOTION, 0, MOTION)
	buffer.fill(Store.Time, slot * TIME, 0, TIME)
	writei32(Store.Marks, slot * MARKS, 0)
	writeu8(Store.Flags, slot, 0)
	buffer.fill(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES, 0, SCALES)
	buffer.fill(Store.Cold, slot * COLD, 0, COLD)
	buffer.fill(Store.HomingTimers, slot * HOMING, 0, HOMING)
	return slot
end

local function addSource(source: any): number
	if source == nil then
		return 0
	end
	local index = sourceIndex[source]
	if not index then
		index = table.remove(freeSources) or #Store.Sources + 1
		sourceIndex[source] = index
		Store.Sources[index] = source
		sourceRefs[index] = 0
	end
	sourceRefs[index] += 1
	return index
end

local function dropSource(index: number)
	if index == 0 then
		return
	end
	sourceRefs[index] -= 1
	if sourceRefs[index] == 0 then
		sourceIndex[Store.Sources[index]] = nil
		Store.Sources[index] = nil
		table.insert(freeSources, index)
	end
end

-- REPACK fields: what a worker's packed copy of a projectile depends on
-- besides the record -- its motion constants (Sweep.MotionSpec) and what
-- makes it eligible for the workers at all (Homing, lag compensation).
-- Writing one mid-flight marks the record Dirty, so that frame's worker
-- result is discarded, the projectile steps serially with the new value and
-- is repacked (or stays serial, e.g. once it has Homing). On a full
-- projectile they live in a side table (`_w`) instead of on the table itself,
-- so that writing them reaches __newindex.
local REPACK = {
	Acceleration = true, AccelerationDirection = true, Gravity = true, MinSpeed = true, MaxSpeed = true,
	Radius = true, Lifetime = true, Homing = true, RewindSeconds = true,
}

-- The metatable full (table-backed) live projectiles get: hot fields go to
-- the record, REPACK fields to `_w`, anything else is an ordinary field (or
-- a method from `class`).
function Store.Metatable(class: any): any
	return {
		__index = function(self: any, key: any): any
			local kind = HOT[key]
			if kind then
				return read(self._slot, kind)
			end
			if REPACK[key] then
				local watched = rawget(self, "_w")
				if watched then
					return watched[key]
				end
			end
			return class[key]
		end,
		__newindex = function(self: any, key: any, value: any)
			local kind = HOT[key]
			if kind then
				write(self._slot, kind, value)
				return
			end
			local watched = REPACK[key] and rawget(self, "_w")
			if watched then
				watched[key] = value
				flag(self._slot, DIRTY, true)
				return
			end
			rawset(self, key, value)
		end,
	}
end

local NIL = newproxy() -- an extras entry meaning "overridden to nil"

-- The metatable of an efficient projectile handle built from `spec` (see the
-- module comment). `lazy[key]()` makes a value the first time it's read
-- (signals, scratch tables) and keeps it in the handle's extras.
function Store.HandleMetatable(spec: any, class: any, lazy: { [string]: () -> any }): any
	return {
		__index = function(self: any, key: any): any
			local kind = HOT[key]
			if kind then
				local slot = rawget(self, "_slot")
				if slot then
					return read(slot, kind)
				end
				-- released: its record fields were kept in one array (see Release)
				local dead = rawget(self, "_dead")
				return dead and dead[kind]
			end
			local extras = rawget(self, "_x")
			if extras then
				local value = extras[key]
				if value ~= nil then
					return if value == NIL then nil else value
				end
			end
			local make = lazy[key]
			if make then
				local value = make()
				if not extras then
					extras = {}
					rawset(self, "_x", extras)
				end
				extras[key] = value
				return value
			end
			local value = spec[key]
			if value ~= nil then
				return value
			end
			return class[key]
		end,
		__newindex = function(self: any, key: any, value: any)
			local kind = HOT[key]
			local slot = rawget(self, "_slot")
			if kind then
				if slot then
					write(slot, kind, value)
					return
				end
				local dead = rawget(self, "_dead")
				if dead then
					dead[kind] = value
					return
				end
			end
			local extras = rawget(self, "_x")
			if value == nil then
				if spec[key] == nil then
					-- nothing to shadow: just drop any override
					if extras then
						extras[key] = nil
					end
					return
				end
				value = NIL
			end
			if not extras then
				extras = {}
				rawset(self, "_x", extras)
			end
			extras[key] = value
			if slot and REPACK[key] then
				flag(slot, DIRTY, true)
			end
		end,
	}
end

-- A field's value if it already exists, without creating a lazy one (so
-- firing or cleaning up a signal nobody connected to costs nothing).
function Store.Peek(state: any, key: string): any
	local value = rawget(state, key)
	if value ~= nil then
		return value
	end
	local extras = rawget(state, "_x")
	value = extras and extras[key]
	return if value == NIL then nil else value
end

-- Moves hot fields into a fresh record and gives `state` `metatable`.
-- They're read from `values` (default: `state` itself, whose copies are then
-- removed); Visualize / Beam / Source come from there too. Returns `state`.
function Store.Adopt(state: any, metatable: any, values: any?): any
	local from = values or state
	local slot = allocate()
	for key, kind in HOT do
		local value = rawget(from, key)
		if from == state then
			rawset(state, key, nil)
		end
		write(slot, kind, value)
	end
	local flags = band(readu8(Store.Flags, slot), bnot(DIRTY))
	if rawget(from, "Visualize") then
		flags = bor(flags, VISUALIZE)
	end
	if rawget(from, "Beam") ~= nil then
		flags = bor(flags, BEAM)
	end
	writeu8(Store.Flags, slot, flags)
	writeu32(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES + 8, addSource(rawget(from, "Source")))
	if from == state then
		local watched = {}
		for key in REPACK do
			watched[key] = rawget(state, key)
			rawset(state, key, nil)
		end
		rawset(state, "_w", watched)
	end
	rawset(state, "_slot", slot)
	return setmetatable(state, metatable)
end

-- Store.Adopt for a fresh efficient handle from plain values (no temporary
-- table: Projectile.Fire's path). Age, debt, mark and the stream flags start
-- at 0 / false.
function Store.AdoptFast(handle: any, metatable: any, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, timeScale: number,
	id: number, spawnTime: number, lastScale: number, visualize: boolean, source: any): any
	local slot = allocate()
	local m = slot * MOTION
	writeVector(Store.Motion, m, position)
	writeVector(Store.Motion, m + 12, velocity)
	writef64(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES, timeScale)
	writeu32(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES + 8, addSource(source))
	local c = slot * COLD
	writef64(Store.Cold, c, id)
	writef64(Store.Cold, c + 8, spawnTime)
	writef64(Store.Cold, c + 16, lastScale)
	writeu8(Store.Flags, slot, if visualize then VISUALIZE else 0)
	rawset(handle, "_slot", slot)
	return setmetatable(handle, metatable)
end

-- Copies a projectile's hot fields back into its table as plain fields
-- (so a kept handle still reads them), gives it `metatable` if one is given
-- (a full projectile goes back to the class; an efficient handle keeps its
-- own) and frees its record. No-op if it has none.
function Store.Release(state: any, metatable: any?)
	local slot = rawget(state, "_slot")
	if not slot then
		return
	end
	dropSource(readu32(Store.Scales, slot * SCALES + 8))
	rawset(state, "_slot", nil)
	if metatable then
		-- a full projectile becomes a plain table again
		setmetatable(state, metatable)
		for key, kind in HOT do
			rawset(state, key, read(slot, kind))
		end
	else
		-- an efficient handle keeps its metatable, which reads these by kind:
		-- one array instead of growing the handle's own hash several times
		local dead = table.create(KIND_COUNT)
		for kind = 1, KIND_COUNT do
			dead[kind] = read(slot, kind)
		end
		rawset(state, "_dead", dead)
	end
	local watched = rawget(state, "_w")
	if watched then
		rawset(state, "_w", nil)
		for key, value in watched do
			rawset(state, key, value)
		end
	end
	Store.Generation[slot] += 1
	table.insert(free, slot)
end

-- A plain copy of a projectile (live or released): its fields, hot ones
-- included, with no record and no metatable -- ready for Adopt.
function Store.CloneRaw(state: any): any
	local copy = table.clone(state)
	setmetatable(copy, nil)
	local slot = rawget(state, "_slot")
	if slot then
		for key, kind in HOT do
			rawset(copy, key, read(slot, kind))
		end
		rawset(copy, "_slot", nil)
	end
	local watched = rawget(state, "_w")
	if watched then
		rawset(copy, "_w", nil)
		for key, value in watched do
			rawset(copy, key, value)
		end
	end
	return copy
end

function Store.MarkDirty(slot: number)
	flag(slot, DIRTY, true)
end

function Store.ClearDirty(slot: number)
	flag(slot, DIRTY, false)
end

-- Live slots (for the Stats tab).
function Store.Count(): number
	return used - #free
end

return Store
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/Projectile/Store.luau
